title: ROS 2 MediaPipe Robotic Hand: Real-Time Teleoperation Digital Twin
description:
A fully containerized, vision-based digital twin of a 15-DOF robotic hand. A standard RGB webcam feeds Google MediaPipe Hands, whose 21 spatial landmarks are converted into 15 anatomical joint angles by vector dot product, normalized into a flexion ratio, and linearly interpolated onto the mechanical joint limits of a CAD-exported URDF. The resulting joint states drive a digital twin in ROS 2 Jazzy and RViz in real time.

The stack runs as a set of Docker Compose services on ROS 2 Jazzy with X11 forwarding, GPU and webcam passthrough, and includes the complete CAD-to-URDF export pipeline from Onshape. The repository ships approximately 12,000 words of engineering documentation covering the MediaPipe two-stage cascade, the kinematic mapping mathematics, the ROS 2 node graph, container infrastructure, and an honest audit of the CAD export's defects.
